title: NAAC A++ Accreditated
description: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, (formerly SRM University) has been recently accredited with the highest grade A++ (3.58/4.0) by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) for 16.08.2018 – 15.08.2023. It is another feather on SRMIST’s cap as it prides over being awarded the highest ranking given to institutions. In the new accreditation process, about 70% weightage is assigned to quantitative metrics.

title: University Grants Commission
description:
SRMIST has been placed under Category I University by UGC / Ministry of Education as per the UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION [CATEGORIZATION OF UNIVERSITIES (ONLY) FOR GRANT OF GRADED AUTONOMY] REGULATIONS, 2018 
By becoming Category I University with 12 B Status, SRMIST is in elite group of 2 Central Universities, 12 State Universities and 11 Deemed to be Universities in India. In Tamil Nadu, only three Universities, including SRMIST, have been granted this rare distinction.
